dedupe_keys.name: notices to skippers dataset of waterway events on the rhine main and danube from euris 2023 onwards

description: This dataset contains Notices to Skippers (NtS) from Europe's navigable inland waterways, focused on events that influence traffic on the Rhine, Main and Danube. Each notice gives details of infrastructure and traffic conditions, and the dataset holds all registered events from January 2023 with start and end times, event types, descriptions, coordinates and identification codes of affected objects such as locks, berths, bridges and fairways. The notices were retrieved systematically from the API of the EuRIS portal, which integrates River Information Services and aggregates data from inland waterway management organisations in 13 European countries, including the original XML messages. The data were deposited by Juan Manuel Pulido Guzmán in 2025 with a paper in the Journal of Transport Geography, with an earlier version on Zenodo and copies on Mendeley Data. Coverage is continental. The latest Zenodo version is free under CC BY 4.0 (an earlier version used CC BY-SA 4.0). Caveats: the data reflect what authorities published as notices, and the record gives no update schedule. The events support analysis of disruptions such as lock closures and low water, reliability and resilience studies of inland navigation, and exposure of waterway objects. They complement the Rhine water level forecasts and the Polish WIR inland navigation portal catalogued here.
